title: Black Eagle Consulting
summary: A Sabbat pack that hides behind a computer firm.

claims.text: Members gather face to face rarely, for great rites or real need, and otherwise keeps in touch by e-mail, chat and phone several times a week.
It began in 1877 amid Sabbat raids on Midwestern telegraph stations, when a templar saw that fast communication could offset the Camarilla's social reach.
Its members frame targets with sparse planted clues; since vampires leave prints only in oily matter, one may keep a target's computer clean with maintenance oils and gather prints over time.

title: Lucita After the Cardinal
summary: The best-known independent Lasombra, after the sire's end.

claims.text: Lucita joined the Assamite strike that destroyed the Cardinal, Lucita's sire, expecting peace at last; it did not come.
The sire's presence in Lucita's mind is gone, and mediums and necromancers find no trace of the soul, but the ideas and challenges remain.
Undoing the sire's aims was never the whole of Lucita's purpose; now that the Cardinal is destroyed, the other motives sit together in unfamiliar ways.

title: Demba Makemba Adoula, called Conrad
summary: A Lasombra shaped by the Belgian Congo.

claims.text: Adoula grew up in the Congo while Leopold's Belgian regime held it, when soldiers and fortune hunters stripped the land and disease emptied whole villages.
Adoula thinks talk of Gehenna absurd, since some world is always ending.
Adoula watches where persecution falls, and teaches recruits Lasombra history and powers.

title: Baloh
summary: A Lasombra from a farm outside Nanking.

claims.text: Baloh's father and three brothers died in a failed revolt against the Qing, while Baloh stayed on the family farm outside Nanking.
Sunk in despair, Baloh became an opium user who fell into rages rather than stupor, which drew the notice of Nanking's Lasombra brood.
